end.parentNote: Kavya practised identifying festival customs and linking harvest festivals with the season when crops are ready. They recalled details about Diwali and Christmas, but the idea that harvest festival dates relate to farming and seasons was not corrected by the end. At home, use a simple picture calendar to find a harvest festival and discuss which crops may be ready then.
